description: Campaign-level TRUE budget-utilisation for a marketplace over ONE period, one row per campaign (grouped by merchant + marketing_campaign_id). Per campaign it returns daily_budget (most-recent-day wallet-capped budget), total_budget (period sum of wallet-capped budget), spend (period ad spend), wallet_balance (most-recent remaining wallet), and budget_utilization (spend / capped budget). Budget is capped by the client's remaining wallet: if daily spend exceeds the converted remaining wallet the spend is used, else the smaller of wallet vs daily_budget. Money is in the campaign's native currency (marketing_campaign_dimensions_daily.currency); the USD wallet is converted to that currency. Filter by campaign_type / campaign_subtype to isolate PLA (PERFORMANCE / SMART_SHOPPING, OS_ADS_SEARCH, VIDEO_MIDROLL, CAMPAIGN_V2) vs Display (INVENTORY / AUCTION), by effective_status, seller_id, or marketing_campaign_id.

os_client_id.description: OnlineSales client id of the merchant that owns the campaign (working id for internal analysis). Filter by this to scope to specific merchants.

seller_id.description: Seller (merchant) id of the campaign owner (working id for internal analysis).

merchant_name.description: Human-readable name / alias of the merchant that owns the campaign.

marketing_campaign_id.description: OnlineSales marketing campaign id (the campaign key). Filter by this to scope to a specific campaign.

marketing_campaign_name.description: Human-readable name / alias of the marketing campaign.

effective_status.description: Effective delivery status of the campaign (e.g. ACTIVE, PAUSED). Filter by this to isolate active vs inactive campaigns.

campaign_type.description: Campaign type: PERFORMANCE (PLA) or INVENTORY (Display). Use as a per-call FILTER to scope to a program type.

campaign_subtype.description: Campaign subtype: PLA = SMART_SHOPPING / OS_ADS_SEARCH / VIDEO_MIDROLL / CAMPAIGN_V2; Display = AUCTION. Use as a per-call FILTER to scope to a program type.

daily_budget.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(MAX_BY(CASE WHEN cbs.remaining_budget_usd IS NOT NULL AND camp_bud.daily_spend IS NOT NULL AND camp_bud.daily_spend > (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) THEN camp_bud.daily_spend WHEN cbs.remaining_budget_usd IS NOT NULL AND (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) <= camp_bud.daily_budget THEN (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) ELSE camp_bud.daily_budget END, camp_bud.date), 2), 0)
daily_budget.description: Most-recent-day wallet-capped budget for the campaign, in the campaign's native currency (MAX_BY over date). Capped by the client's converted remaining wallet balance.

total_budget.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cbs.remaining_budget_usd IS NOT NULL AND camp_bud.daily_spend IS NOT NULL AND camp_bud.daily_spend > (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) THEN camp_bud.daily_spend WHEN cbs.remaining_budget_usd IS NOT NULL AND (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) <= camp_bud.daily_budget THEN (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) ELSE camp_bud.daily_budget END), 2), 0)
total_budget.description: Period sum of the daily wallet-capped budget for the campaign, in the campaign's native currency.

spend.description: Total ad spend for the campaign over the period, in the campaign's native currency.

wallet_balance.description: Most-recent-day remaining wallet balance of the client, converted from USD to the campaign's native currency (MAX_BY over date).

budget_utilization.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(camp_bud.daily_spend), SUM(CASE WHEN cbs.remaining_budget_usd IS NOT NULL AND camp_bud.daily_spend IS NOT NULL AND camp_bud.daily_spend > (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) THEN camp_bud.daily_spend WHEN cbs.remaining_budget_usd IS NOT NULL AND (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) <= camp_bud.daily_budget THEN (cbs.remaining_budget_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) ELSE camp_bud.daily_budget END)), 2), 0)
budget_utilization.description: True budget utilisation for the campaign = period spend / period wallet-capped budget (BU fraction, e.g. 0.85 = 85%).

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM (SELECT mcdd.date AS date, ag.agency_id AS agency_id, cl.client_id AS client_id, mcd.marketing_campaign_id AS marketing_campaign_id, mcd.alias AS marketing_campaign_name, mcdd.effective_status AS effective_status, mcdd.currency AS currency, mcd.campaign_type AS campaign_type, mcd.campaign_subtype AS campaign_subtype, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN mcdd.effective_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN mcdd.daily_budget * scc.conversion_factor WHEN mcdd.effective_status != 'ACTIVE' AND mcdd.cost > 0 THEN mcdd.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 2) AS daily_budget, ROUND(SUM(mcdd.cost * scc.conversion_factor), 2) AS daily_spend FROM reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions_daily AS mcdd JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions AS mcd ON mcd.client_id = mcdd.client_id AND mcd.marketing_campaign_id = mcdd.marketing_campaign_id JOIN reporting.clients AS cl ON cl.client_id = mcdd.client_id AND cl.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' JOIN reporting.agencies AS ag ON ag.agency_id = cl.agency_id AND ag.marketplace_client_id != cl.client_id AND ag.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = mcdd.currency AND scc.to_currency = mcdd.currency WHERE mcd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' AND mcdd.date >= '__START_DATE_1__' AND mcdd.date <= '__END_DATE_1__' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) AS camp_bud JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc2 ON scc2.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc2.to_currency = camp_bud.currency JOIN reporting.client_budget_snapshot AS cbs ON cbs.agency_id = camp_bud.agency_id AND cbs.client_id = camp_bud.client_id AND cbs.date = camp_bud.date JOIN reporting.clients AS clients ON clients.client_id = cbs.client_id AND clients.agency_id = cbs.agency_id WHERE cbs.date >= '__START_DATE_1__' AND cbs.date <= '__END_DATE_1__' AND cbs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
